fanoutqa_003715.t: Demographic history of New York City :: Citywide :: part 01 :: chunk_0002
fanoutqa_003715.x:
Demographic history of New York City :: Citywide :: part 01 :: chunk_0002
The [1890 United States census](/wiki/1890_United_States_census "1890 United States census") showed a total population of 1,515,301, the foreign-born were 639,943 at 42%. The city did not trust the accuracy of the census so conducted an 1890 New York City Police census. This census revealed a population of 1,710,715.[[8]](#cite_note-8)
During the early 20th century, from 1900 to 1940, New York City's population was predominantly White, accounting for over 93% of the population, with the Black community constituting less than 3%. By the 1950s, the White population decreased to around 90%, while the Black population increased to nearly 10%. From 1970 to 1980, more pronounced shifts occurred, with the White population dropping to 60.72%, the Black population increasing to 25.23%, and a notable rise in the Hispanic/Latino population to 19.88%. The 1990s brought further diversification, with the White population falling to 44.66% by 2000, and growth in the Black, Asian, and Hispanic/Latino populations. The most recent decade from 2010 to 2020 saw a continued decrease in the White population to 34.09%, significant growth in the Asian population to 15.73%, stability in the Black population around 22-25%, and growth in the Hispanic/Latino community to 28.29%. The Other or Mixed category also grew to 28.11%. Throughout this period, New York City remained a hub for immigrants, with the foreign-born population peaking at 37.51% in 2010. Overall, these trends reflect the transformation of New York City into an increasingly multicultural metropolis, with a progressive decline in the White population and expanding representation of Black, Asian, Hispanic/Latino, and Other or Mixed groups.[[1]](#cite_note-nycrace-1)[[9]](#cite_note-9)

Mai Zen'in (禪院 真依, *Zen'in Mai*) is a second-year Kyoto Jujutsu High sorcerer and Maki's estranged twin sister. Unlike Maki, Mai possesses a Construction (構築術式, *Kōchiku Jutsushiki*) technique that materializes objects from Cursed Energy, though her limited reserves make this exhausting. Primarily using a Cursed Energy-infused revolver, she keeps her technique secret for tactical advantage. Fatally wounded by their father during the Shibuya Incident, Mai expends her remaining energy to forge a replica of Toji Fushiguro's Split Soul Katana for Maki. This final act enables Maki's destruction of the Zen'in clan while serving as their last connection.

[James Horner](/wiki/James_Horner "James Horner") composed the musical score for *Avatar*, his third collaboration with Cameron after *[Aliens](/wiki/Aliens_(film) "Aliens (film)")* and *[Titanic](/wiki/Titanic_(1997_film) "Titanic (1997 film)")*.[[109]](#cite_note-120) He worked with Wanda Bryant, an [ethnomusicologist](/wiki/Ethnomusicology "Ethnomusicology"), to create a music culture for the [Na'vi](/wiki/Na%27vi "Na'vi"), and recorded parts of the score with a small chorus singing in the [Na'vi](/wiki/Na%27vi "Na'vi") language in March 2008.[[l]](#cite_note-124) Horner promised Cameron that he would devote his attention solely to *Avatar* and no other projects, and he reportedly worked on the score from four in the morning until ten at night throughout the process. He stated in an interview that it was the most difficult scored he had worked on.[[113]](#cite_note-125) He composed the score as two different scores merged into one. He first created a score that reflected the Na'vi way of sound and then combined it with a separate "traditional" score to drive the film.[[79]](#cite_note-makingofavatar-89) [Leona Lewis](/wiki/Leona_Lewis "Leona Lewis") sang the theme song for the film, called "[I See You](/wiki/I_See_You_(Theme_from_Avatar) "I See You (Theme from Avatar)")". An accompanying music video, directed by [Jake Nava](/wiki/Jake_Nava "Jake Nava"), premiered December 15, 2009, on [MySpace](/wiki/Myspace "Myspace").[[114]](#cite_note-126)

From its discovery in 1846 until the [discovery of Pluto](/wiki/Discovery_of_Pluto "Discovery of Pluto") in 1930, Neptune was the farthest known planet. When [Pluto](/wiki/Pluto "Pluto") was discovered, it was considered a planet, and Neptune thus became the second-farthest known planet, except for a 20-year period between 1979 and 1999 when Pluto's elliptical orbit brought it closer than Neptune to the Sun, making Neptune the ninth planet from the Sun during this period.[[67]](#cite_note-73)[[68]](#cite_note-74) The increasingly accurate estimations of Pluto's mass from ten times [that of Earth's](/wiki/Earth_mass "Earth mass") to far less than [that of the Moon](/wiki/Lunar_mass "Lunar mass")[[69]](#cite_note-75) and the discovery of the [Kuiper belt](/wiki/Kuiper_belt "Kuiper belt") in 1992 led many astronomers to debate whether Pluto should be considered a planet or as part of the Kuiper belt.[[70]](#cite_note-76)[[71]](#cite_note-77) In 2006, the [International Astronomical Union](/wiki/International_Astronomical_Union "International Astronomical Union") [defined the word "planet"](/wiki/IAU_definition_of_planet "IAU definition of planet") for the first time, reclassifying Pluto as a "[dwarf planet](/wiki/Dwarf_planet "Dwarf planet")" and making Neptune once again the outermost-known planet in the Solar System.[[72]](#cite_note-78)

Salem is located in the north-central [Willamette Valley](/wiki/Willamette_Valley "Willamette Valley"), in [Marion](/wiki/Marion_County,_Oregon "Marion County, Oregon") and [Polk](/wiki/Polk_County,_Oregon "Polk County, Oregon") counties. The [45th Parallel](/wiki/45th_parallel_north "45th parallel north") (roughly the halfway point between the [North Pole](/wiki/North_Pole "North Pole") and the [Equator](/wiki/Equator "Equator")) passes through Salem's city limits.

According to the [United States Census Bureau](/wiki/United_States_Census_Bureau "United States Census Bureau"), the city has a total area of 49.495 square miles (128.19 km2), of which 48.944 square miles (126.76 km2) is land and 0.551 square miles (1.43 km2) (1.11%) is water.[[20]](#cite_note-CenPopGazetteer2024-20)

Although the [Willamette River](/wiki/Willamette_River "Willamette River") flows through Salem, the [North Santiam River](/wiki/North_Santiam_River "North Santiam River") [watershed](/wiki/Drainage_basin "Drainage basin") is Salem's primary drinking water source. Other important streams that pass through Salem are [Mill Creek](/wiki/Mill_Creek_(Marion_County,_Oregon) "Mill Creek (Marion County, Oregon)"), the Mill Race, [Pringle Creek](/wiki/Pringle_Creek_(Willamette_River_tributary) "Pringle Creek (Willamette River tributary)"), and [Shelton Ditch](/wiki/Shelton_Ditch_(Oregon) "Shelton Ditch (Oregon)").[[21]](#cite_note-Creeks-21) Smaller streams in the southern and southeastern parts of the city include Clark Creek, Jory Creek, Battle Creek, Croisan Creek, and Claggett Creek, while Glen Creek and Brush Creek flow through [West Salem](/wiki/West_Salem,_Salem,_Oregon "West Salem, Salem, Oregon").[[21]](#cite_note-Creeks-21)

Elevation within the city limits ranges from about 120 to 800 feet (37 to 244 m). Salem contains the volcanic [Salem Hills](/wiki/Salem_Hills "Salem Hills") in the south and is sandwiched by the 1,000 ft (300 m) Eola Hills directly to the west and the 600 ft (180 m) [Waldo Hills](/wiki/Waldo_Hills "Waldo Hills") to the east. The African Great Lakes region contains the source of the Nile as well as several large lakes that are part of the Nile River system: [Lake Victoria](/wiki/Lake_Victoria "Lake Victoria"), [Lake Albert](/wiki/Lake_Albert_(Africa) "Lake Albert (Africa)"), [Lake George](/wiki/Lake_George_(Uganda) "Lake George (Uganda)"), and [Lake Edward](/wiki/Lake_Edward "Lake Edward").[[33]](#cite_note-43) The source of the Nile is the [Rukarara River](/wiki/Rukarara_River "Rukarara River") within Rwanda's Nyungwe National Park,[[2]](#cite_note-SourceCite-2) and it leads to the [Kagera River](/wiki/Kagera_River "Kagera River") which drains into Lake Victoria.[[9]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHurst2025-12)[[f]](#cite_note-sourceRivSequence-28) Although it is a large lake – the [second-largest freshwater lake](/wiki/List_of_lakes_by_area "List of lakes by area") in the world[[k]](#cite_note-45) – Lake Victoria is relatively shallow, with an average depth of 40 meters (130 ft).[[35]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTETvedt2021214-46) The Nile River first assumes the name "Nile" where Lake Victoria empties on its north side: the stretch from there to Lake Albert is called the Victoria Nile.[[9]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHurst2025-12) A pair of waterfalls – [Ripon Falls](/wiki/Ripon_Falls "Ripon Falls") and [Owen Falls](/wiki/Owen_Falls "Owen Falls") – were located where the Nile exits Lake Victoria, but have both been submerged by the construction of the [Nalubaale dam](/wiki/Nalubaale_dam "Nalubaale dam"). After [Bujagali Falls](/wiki/Bujagali_Falls "Bujagali Falls") and [Bujagali Power Station](/wiki/Bujagali_Power_Station "Bujagali Power Station"), the Victoria Nile empties into [Lake Kyoga](/wiki/Lake_Kyoga "Lake Kyoga"). After exiting Lake Kyoga, the river is joined by the [River Kafu](/wiki/River_Kafu "River Kafu") tributary, then passes over [Murchison Falls](/wiki/Murchison_Falls "Murchison Falls") and flows into Lake Albert. Unlike Lake Victoria, Lake Albert is a deep lake surrounded by mountains. In 1386, Heidelberg University was founded by [Rupert I](/wiki/Rupert_I,_Elector_Palatine "Rupert I, Elector Palatine") on instruction of [Pope Urban VI](/wiki/Pope_Urban_VI "Pope Urban VI") who demanded modelling it after the ancient [University of Paris](/wiki/University_of_Paris "University of Paris").

The [Great Schism](/wiki/Western_Schism "Western Schism") of 1378 made it possible for Heidelberg, a relatively small city and capital of the [Electorate of the Palatinate](/wiki/Electorate_of_the_Palatinate "Electorate of the Palatinate"), to gain its own university.[[19]](#cite_note-Cser31-19) The Great Schism was initiated by the election of two popes after the death of [Pope Gregory XI](/wiki/Pope_Gregory_XI "Pope Gregory XI") in the same year.[[19]](#cite_note-Cser31-19) One successor resided in [Avignon](/wiki/Avignon "Avignon") (elected by the French) and the other in Rome (elected by the Italian cardinals).[[19]](#cite_note-Cser31-19) The German secular and spiritual leaders voiced their support for the successor in Rome, which had far-reaching consequences for the German students and teachers in Paris: they lost their stipends and had to leave.[[20]](#cite_note-20)

[Rupert I](/wiki/Rupert_I,_Elector_Palatine_of_the_Rhine "Rupert I, Elector Palatine of the Rhine") recognized the opportunity and initiated talks with the [Curia](/wiki/Roman_Curia "Roman Curia"), which ultimately led to a [papal bull](/wiki/Papal_bull "Papal bull") for foundation of a university. After having received, on 23 October 1385, permission from pope [Urban VI](/wiki/Urban_VI "Urban VI") to create a school of general studies ([Latin](/wiki/Latin_language "Latin language"): *studium generale*), the final decision to found the university was taken on 26 June 1386 at the behest of Rupert I, [Count Palatine of the Rhine](/wiki/Count_Palatine_of_the_Rhine "Count Palatine of the Rhine").[[21]](#cite_note-Wolgast3-21) As specified in the papal charter, the university was mod

Lee Sedol in 2012

Lee Sedol is a professional Go player of [9 dan rank](/wiki/Go_ranks_and_ratings "Go ranks and ratings")[[34]](#cite_note-gobase-34) and is one of the strongest players in the [history of Go](/wiki/History_of_Go "History of Go"). He started his career in 1996 (promoted to professional dan rank at the age of 12), winning 18 international titles since then.[[35]](#cite_note-35) He is a "national hero" in his native South Korea, known for his unconventional and creative play.[[36]](#cite_note-markzastrow-36) Lee Sedol initially predicted he would defeat AlphaGo in a "landslide".[[36]](#cite_note-markzastrow-36) Some weeks before the match he won the Korean [Myungin](/wiki/Myungin "Myungin") title, a major championship.[[37]](#cite_note-37)

Main article: [Abdication of Henri, Grand Duke of Luxembourg](/wiki/Abdication_of_Henri,_Grand_Duke_of_Luxembourg "Abdication of Henri, Grand Duke of Luxembourg")

[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1a/Trounwiessel_2025_EuCo_%28102%29.jpg/250px-Trounwiessel_2025_EuCo_%28102%29.jpg)](/wiki/File:Trounwiessel_2025_EuCo_(102).jpg)

Henri sitting with Guillaume at his abdication ceremony.

On 23 June 2024, his [official birthday](/wiki/Grand_Duke%27s_Official_Birthday "Grand Duke's Official Birthday"), Henri announced his plans to appoint his son [Guillaume](/wiki/Guillaume,_Hereditary_Grand_Duke_of_Luxembourg "Guillaume, Hereditary Grand Duke of Luxembourg") as lieutenant representative ([regent](/wiki/Regent "Regent")) in October. Traditionally, this signals the grand duke's intention to [abdicate](/wiki/Abdication "Abdication") in the future.[[18]](#cite_note-19)[[19]](#cite_note-20) On 8 October, Guillaume was sworn in as lieutenant representative.[[20]](#cite_note-21) On 24 December 2024, Henri announced in his Christmas message his intention to abdicate in favour of Hereditary Grand Duke Guillaume on 3 October 2025.[[21]](#cite_note-abdication-22)

Following his abdication, Henri stated that he would be leaving Luxembourg "for a while".[[22]](#cite_note-23)
